positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Detailed Job Responsibilities: 
•	Develop and test backend services using web API for My Molina mobile app.
•	Recommend and develop upgrades for existing web API.
•	Monitor quality and performance of applications through testing and maintenance.
•	Maintain and support application in DevOps such as Repos, Pipelines, and Artifacts, etc.
•	Coding, testing and debugging backend services.
•	Support offshore team to meet requirement of the application.

Skill Sets:
•	Creativity and innovation
•	Interpersonal and communication with team
•	Analytical
•	Concentration and focus
•	Problem-solving
•	Quick learner
•	Attention to details

Technical skill sets:
•	C#
•	ASP.NET
•	Web API
•	SSRS
•	MS SQL
•	Git
•	DevOps such as Repos, Pipelines, and Artifacts, etc.
•	HTML, CSS, JavaScript
•	Postman
•	Java

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description:
- Code, test, implement, support, and maintain existing Bureau of Street Services Intranet and Internet web application.
- Created small application to load data from Bus Pads database or Access Ramp CSV file in order to upload to LA City open data that is managed by Socrata Company.
- Maintain and troubleshoot any incidents occurred in about 400 PCs

company.name: Bureau of Street Services, City of Los Angeles, CA

positions.title: IT Administrator
positions.description:
- Created application to combine data from member and provider files and export to CSV file to match with third party vendor template.
- Assist all departments generating data from database to Microsoft Excel.
- Trained employees how to use company web portal created by third party vendor.
- Answer user inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems.
- Set up equipment for employees use, ensuring proper installation of cables, operating systems, or appropriate software.
